lexicalDecisions.disposition: Select凱旋がいせん as sole necessary support. Noun+suru intransitive; triumphant return. Daijisen explicitly includes sporting success and successful performance abroad, so not military-only. Do not assert every success involves a physicalreturn or that the word itself guarantees a championship.

凱歌がいか is victory song and victory. Useful plain recognition example if retained, not an extra necessary support article or literal song in every figurative occurrence. Allocation is supported jointly by the character dictionary's explicitガイ/compound list and complete lexicalfamily, not kana substring alone.

凱旋軍がいせんぐん returning victoriousarmy, 凱旋門がいせんもん triumphalarch, 凱旋将軍がいせんしょうぐん triumphantgeneral and凱旋公演がいせんこうえん performance after successfultourabroad are complete separate families. Not necessary extra articles. Public lexicalsupplement independently supports凱旋公演; avoid reducing凱旋 to ordinaryhomecoming.

凱風がいふう is southerlywind. Daijisen charactermeaning2 links it toやわらぐ, but its actual lexicalreading isがいふう, not proof of an ordinary written verb凱 or凱ぐ. Preserve semantic and lexical layers; not selected support and no claim about modernfrequency.
